'''MUQ-751''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] who served as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] company known as the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. As with all B1 [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], MUQ-751<ref name="GB" /> was 1.91 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, had [[Gender/Legends|masculine programming]] and wielded an [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]].<ref name="Clone Wars" /> The droid's head and some other parts of its body were [[Color/Legends|colored]] white, while the rest was brown.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
MUQ-751 appears in the [[2001]] [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. MUQ-751 only appears in the scenario editor mode, where it is a unique unit that can be placed in custom player-made levels. The droid's name can also be randomly generated in the game's skirmish mode as a commander for the Trade Federation. MUQ-751 is identical to several other unique battle droids in the game.<ref name="GB" />
